title: making my coworkers dream come true part 2: opening night edition @He...
transcript: I took the biggest Huey Lewis fan I know to open the night of his new Broadway show, The Heart of rock and Roll. The day started with hotel room glam by the amazing John Gregory makeup. We Facetimed Deirdre's daughter to show her how incredible mom looked. The musical is set in 1987. Our vision was 80s prom, and John delivered with the look we got in our fits. I was feeling my oats, and then it was time to strut to the theater. We even got to go on the neon pink carpet to mix and mingle with all the celebs headed into the show, starting with Huey Lewis himself. We saw Casey Cot, Cindy Lauper, and even Jimmy Kimmel. Deirdre then spotted the news and went over to introduce herself and thank them for their music. After a casual bump in with Riverdale's Casey Cop, we did some prom poses, and then it was time to head into the theater for the star of the show. We chatted with Roxy Hart and Huey Intermission. But as the cast took their vows, all Deirdre could say was amazing. And that is the perfect word to describe this show in the electric cast that brings it to life. To quote the New York Post, it's the highlight of the season and one of the most fun times I've had at a Broadway show. And surprise, Huey Lewis came on stage to thank the team for all their hard work and Due to was unwell. But the night wasn't over yet because we had the after party to attend. If this night was a Yankee Candle, the fragrance would be named power of love, because that is the palpable feeling the heart of rock and roll on Broadway brings.
